fact: The Annuaire 2023 du SNISS sources its 2023 tables of consultations for third-reference hospitals (CHU), second-reference regional hospitals and the first-reference level by region to 'Annuaires SIH 2023 et DHIS2', sources its first-level tables to 'Annuaire SLIS 2023 et DHIS2', and gives from DHIS2, as at 29 May 2025, a register of 10,867 functional health structures including 1,758 CSCom, 66 CSRéf and 15 hospitals; it states no share of CSCom entering their own reports, and its only completeness table is for weekly epidemiological surveillance reports (91.6% in 2023, 56.8% on time, source DHIS2 28/04/2024).
title: Annuaire 2023 du Système National d'Information Sanitaire et Social (SNISS)
publisher: Cellule de Planification et de Statistique du Secteur Santé, Développement Social et Promotion de la Famille (CPS/SSDSPF)
